# Pinnacle Sales

> Pinnacle Sales is a manufacturer's representative firm for kitchen and bath cabinetry, serving independent dealers in ten Western US states since 2001. It represents Shiloh, Eclipse, and Aspect Cabinetry and Vistora Closets (all WW Wood Products), Pronorm German Kitchens, and US Stone. The dealer is the customer: Pinnacle does not sell to homeowners and does not publish a dealer locator.

Not to be confused with Pinnacle Sales Group (a Florida appliance and outdoor-living distributor) or Pinnacle Sales in Pittsburgh (a plumbing and heating rep agency). This firm is at pinnaclesales.biz.

## Key facts

- Type: independent manufacturer's representative (rep firm) for kitchen and bath dealers. Founded 2001.
- Territory for WW Wood brands: Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Utah, Washington. Dealer territories are protected.
- Pronorm German Kitchens: represented nationwide through European Kitchen Distributors (EKD), the exclusive US agent for Pronorm, led by Pinnacle Sales.
- Team: Scott Miller, Principal (AZ, ID, MT, NM). Ben Miller, Partner and President of EKD (CA, UT, NV). Kara Hayes (CO). Josh Polvogt (WA, OR). Gillian Patriquin, dealer and training specialist.
- Dealer support: sales training, showroom merchandising, 2020 and Winner design and quoting, technical help, marketing resources, factory tours.
- Contact: +1 480-993-9224, marketing@pinnaclesales.biz.

## Brands

- [Shiloh Cabinetry](https://pinnaclesales.biz/brands/shiloh-cabinetry/): face-frame and inset semi-custom, all-plywood box, about 6-week lead time. Built by WW Wood Products, Dudley, Missouri.
- [Eclipse Cabinetry](https://pinnaclesales.biz/brands/eclipse-cabinetry/): frameless full-access from the same factory, same door styles and finishes as Shiloh at comparable pricing.
- [Aspect Cabinetry](https://pinnaclesales.biz/brands/aspect-cabinetry/): value semi-custom for builder and budget work; same WW Wood finish quality, fewer options.
- [Vistora Closets](https://pinnaclesales.biz/brands/vistora-closets/): made-to-order closet and storage line by WW Wood Products.
- [Pronorm German Kitchens](https://pinnaclesales.biz/brands/pronorm-german-kitchens/): German fitted kitchens built in Vlotho since 1972, American 24-inch depths as standard, typical installs $40,000 to $150,000+.
- [US Stone](https://pinnaclesales.biz/brands/us-stone-group/): luxury stone surfaces including Cristallo and Patagonia.
